description: This source file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel library, specifically testing read-only behaviors, cloning, serialization/deserialization, recursive element retrieval, and style usage within a document object model.

classes.name: ReadOnlyTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests validating the behavior of document object cloning, serialization, style retrieval, and element iteration in the MigraDoc Document Object Model.

methods.name: Test_Clone
methods.description: Verifies that cloning a document preserves its structure without unintended modifications.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl
methods.description: Tests writing a document to a string in MDDDL format and reading it back, ensuring data integrity.

methods.name: Test_GetElementsRecursively
methods.description: Checks that retrieving elements recursively from a document does not alter its state.

methods.name: Test_GetText
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving the text from a table cell does not change the document content.

methods.name: Test_GetUsedFormatValue
methods.description: Ensures style formatting values can be retrieved correctly and match expected values.
